args.query:
SELECT category, SUM( (EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(lead.completed_ts) - completed_ts)) ) AS seconds_spent
FROM (
  SELECT v.*,
    LEAD(completed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY completed_ts) AS lead_completed_ts
  FROM fct_value_moments v
) vm
JOIN dim_habits h ON vm.habit_id = h.habit_id
WHERE vm.lead_completed_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND vm.lead_completed_ts > vm.completed_ts
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY seconds_spent DESC;

SELECT
  SUM(1) AS total_value_moments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT completed_ts::date || '-' || user_id || '-' || session_id) AS sessions_placeholder
FROM (
  SELECT *,
    -- define session as same user, same day, and contiguous events within 30 minutes -> we need session ids; simpler: assume session = user + date + session window via lag
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, completed_date ORDER BY completed_ts) as rn,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_ts - LAG(completed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY completed_ts))) > 1800 OR LAG(completed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY completed_ts) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY completed_ts) as session_id
  FROM fct_value_moments
) t;

args.query:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT *,
    LAG(completed_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY completed_ts) AS prev_ts
  FROM fct_value_moments
), sessions AS (
  SELECT *,
    SUM(CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_ts - prev_ts)) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY completed_ts) AS session_seq
  FROM events
), session_counts AS (
  SELECT user_id, completed_date, session_seq,
    MIN(completed_ts) AS session_start,
    COUNT(*) AS habits_completed
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY user_id, completed_date, session_seq
)
SELECT
  SUM(habits_completed) AS total_value_moments,
  COUNT(*) AS total_sessions,
  SUM(habits_completed)::double / COUNT(*) AS avg_habits_per_session
FROM session_counts;
